prompt: Methyl benzoate + excess CH3MgBr (then workup). Draw the tertiary alcohol product.

traps.note: Grignard adds TWICE to an ester (the ketone intermediate is more reactive than the ester).

explanation: First Grignard addition kicks out OMe and gives acetophenone transiently; this ketone is more electrophilic than the ester, so a second equivalent of CH3MgBr adds immediately. Workup gives the tertiary alcohol.
